title: Meme Maze Panic 3D

selected_top_5.reasoning: The dominant loop is staying alive under constant pressure from hostile enemies while managing health and extending a run for a better score.
The game uses a first-person raycast viewpoint, a centered crosshair, real-time enemies, and tap-based attacks, even though the attack is proximity-based rather than projectile shooting.
Each restart generates a fresh maze layout and the player spends the run navigating corridors, locating threats, and seeking collectibles.
Close-range timing and facing matter when purging enemies, creating a simple combat rhythm, but the game lacks duel structure or formal arena rounds.
Enemy pressure resembles ongoing defensive survival, but there are no explicit wave phases or fortified defense systems.

uncertainty_notes: The strongest ambiguity is whether the game should be treated primarily as a survival game or a first-person shooter because it visually resembles an FPS but mechanically uses short-range interaction instead of firearms.
No explicit wave counter, level progression, or objective tiers are present, so categories that imply staged escalation are weaker fits.
The maze is procedurally randomized, but exploration is still in service of survival rather than discovery-driven content.
